# incident.io — account brief

## Who
incident.io is an incident management product that lets teams declare, run, and learn from incidents without leaving Slack ([source](https://incident.io/)). It runs a GitHub org at incident-io ([source](https://github.com/incident-io)).

## Production Expo signals
- The repo incident-io/on-call-app contains an eas.json ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/eas.json)).
- package.json in that repo pins react-native 0.74.3 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows under .github/workflows ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- incident-io/on-call-app was last pushed 2026-08-19 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app)).
- The incident.io org has 38 public repos and 520 followers ([source](https://github.com/incident-io)).
- incident.io On-call has 3,100 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777)).
- The app shipped 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777)).
- An open issue reads "EAS build failing on iOS since Xcode 16 image update" ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/214)).
- An open issue reads "Track: upgrade to Expo SDK 53" ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/198)).

## Who to talk to
- Maintainer One (@incident-io-maintainer-1), top contributor to incident-io/on-call-app with 174 commits; profile lists company incident.io, location Remote, website https://incident.io, and bio "Mobile engineer at incident.io. Maintains the incident.io On-call app (Expo / React Native)." ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-1))
- Maintainer Two (@incident-io-maintainer-2), 92 commits; profile lists company incident.io, location New York, NY, website https://incident.io, and bio "React Native developer on the incident.io mobile team. EAS builds and releases for the incident.io On-call app." ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-2))
- Maintainer Three (@incident-io-maintainer-3), 45 commits; profile lists company incident.io, location San Francisco, CA, website https://incident.io, and bio "Engineer at incident.io. Mostly the incident.io On-call app, sometimes the API." ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-3))

## Why now
The repo was last pushed 2026-08-19 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app)) and the app has had 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777)). It is on react-native 0.74.3 with an open issue tracking an upgrade to Expo SDK 53 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/package.json), [source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/198)).

## Suggested opener
Maintainer Two, your profile says you handle EAS builds and releases for the incident.io On-call app ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-2)). The repo has an open issue titled "EAS build failing on iOS since Xcode 16 image update" ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/214)), alongside another tracking an upgrade to Expo SDK 53 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/198)). How are you handling the Xcode 16 image change in your iOS builds while that SDK 53 upgrade is still open?
